title: PostgreSQL MVCC Internals: Dead Tuples, Table Bloat, and VACUUM Tuning
coreConcept: How Multi-Version Concurrency Control stores xmin/xmax transaction IDs per row, and tuning autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit to prevent disk bloat.
codeSnippet:
-- Checking table bloat and dead tuple counts in PostgreSQL
SELECT relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup, 
       round(100.0 * n_dead_tup / nullif(n_dead_tup + n_live_tup, 0),2) as dead_pct
FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC;

title: PostgreSQL Query Optimization: Reading EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) Output

SELECT customer_id, sum(total) 
FROM orders

title: MySQL InnoDB Internals: Clustered Indexes, Change Buffer, and Redo Log Flushing

innodb_buffer_pool_size = 32G
innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit = 2 # Flush to OS cache on commit, disk every 1s
innodb_log_file_size = 4G

title: Redis Memory Optimization: Jemalloc, Memory Fragmentation, and Maxmemory Evictions

codeSnippet:

maxmemory-policy allkeys-lfu
activedefrag yes
active-defrag-threshold-lower 10

title: Zero-Downtime PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrades with pg_upgrade and Hardlinks
coreConcept: Using pg_upgrade --link mode to upgrade multi-terabyte PostgreSQL databases from v15 to v17 in under 2 minutes without copying data files.
codeSnippet:
# Fast hardlink upgrade
pg_upgrade \
  --old-datadir=/var/lib/postgresql/15/data \
  --new-datadir=/var/lib/postgresql/17/data \
  --old-bindir=/usr/lib/postgresql/15/bin \
  --new-bindir=/usr/lib/postgresql/17/bin \
  --link --check

title: Designing Event Sourced Data Stores with Apache Cassandra and ScyllaDB
coreConcept: Data modeling with partition keys and clustering columns for append-only event journals with predictable sub-5ms write latencies.
codeSnippet:
CREATE TABLE event_journal (
    aggregate_id text,
    sequence_nr bigint,
    event_type text,
    payload blob,
    PRIMARY KEY (aggregate_id, sequence_nr)
) WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (sequence_nr ASC);
